retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist theatrical layout featuring a central charcoal-textured circular swirl topped with a small red ship icon, framed by high-contrast serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, off-white composition centered around a rough, gestural charcoal ring that suggests a wave or a portal. At the apex of this ring sits a small, vibrant red silhouette of a ship. The title is split across the central graphic in a high-contrast serif, while secondary credits are arranged in a clean grid at the bottom using condensed sans-serif and italic serif fonts.
coreVisualRelationships: Central charcoal swirl acts as a frame for the middle word of the title
Small red ship provides the only saturated color focal point
High-contrast serif title creates a horizontal axis through the center
Bottom credit block establishes a stable, rhythmic base
coreInvariants: Single red accent element at the top of the central graphic

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central charcoal ring occupies the middle third of the canvas; title text spans the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The small red ship icon at the top center of the charcoal swirl.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red ship, follows the charcoal swirl downward, moves horizontally across the main title, and settles on the bottom credit grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white negative space around the central motif to emphasize the texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background providing a clean, paper-like canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for the charcoal texture and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the ship icon and the top-left promotional sticker.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with low-value black elements and a single high-saturation red accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast modern serif and condensed sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Display type features extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Vertical stress in the serif characters
Secondary type uses a tall, condensed gothic structure

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered behind or through the swirl

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a utilitarian condensed sans-serif for credits.

preserve: High contrast of the serif font
Condensed nature of the credit font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif style of the main title.
Matches the condensed, bold sans-serif used in the credits.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an off-white textured paper background. In the center, place a rough, circular charcoal-style brush stroke that is thicker at the bottom and tapers at the top. At the very top of the circle, add a small, stylized red silhouette of a ship.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a high-contrast serif font (like Didot) horizontally across the center. Add a grid of credits at the bottom using a condensed bold sans-serif for names and a small italic serif for roles.

verificationChecks: Is the ship icon red and positioned at the top of the swirl?
Is the title font high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Size of the red ship icon
Tracking of the display serif font

mustAchieve: Visible charcoal texture in the central graphic

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red ship is the only saturated color element in the main graphic.
Check that the charcoal texture looks hand-drawn rather than digital.
Verify the title text is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the off-white background has a subtle paper texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central gestural texture + Minimalist icon + High-contrast serif title + Condensed sans-serif footer grid.
